text:
Maya Nguyen: Kicking off the region-by-region rollout now. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, 10% canary, 30m hold per region, health checks + qps/cpu smoke.
Deploy-bot: /deploy release=v3.4.1 regions=us canary=10% hold=30m
Deploy-bot: Started rollout for release v3.4.1 in region US (canary 10%). Job id: r-20260321-01
Liam O'Connor: Quick capacity check — US warm pool at 18% free, baseline qps ~14k. Canary should be fine but watch p50 token latency.
Serena Patel: Added the release notes to the channel thread: reduced KV cache TTL for embeddings, minor tokenizer fix. No model weight changes.
Alex Kim: FYI pinned model variant: redwood/gpt-medium-quant-v2 at the canary nodes. If OOMs, fallback to redwood/gpt-medium-quant-v1 automatically.
Maya Nguyen: Alert criteria for rollback: sustained error rate >1.5% for 5m OR p99 latency increase >2x baseline for 2 consecutive 5m windows. Also manual rollback allowed.
oncall-bot: [metric alert subscriptions enabled] Watching: us/p50, us/p99, us/error_rate, us/gpu_memory.
Liam O'Connor: US canary smoke: p50=62ms, p99=210ms, error_rate=0.2% — looks clean so far.
Deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 30%.
Serena Patel: Running through release smoke tests: chat flow samples, embeddings, streaming. Sending logs if anything pops.
Maya Nguyen: If US stable at 30m, we expand EU to 5% initial canary and repeat. No cross-region traffic shift until EU passes hold.
Alex Kim: EU capacity quick read: reserved pool 45% used, available headroom ~22% for burst. Will pre-warm an extra two hosts if observed qps>baseline+20%.
Deploy-bot: /deploy release=v3.4.1 regions=eu canary=5% hold=30m -- queued, waiting for US hold completion
Liam O'Connor: Noted — also enabling KV prefix caching in EU for the new TTL to avoid spike.
Maya Nguyen: US passed hold at +31m, all checks green. Proceeding to stagger EU rollout now.
Deploy-bot: Started rollout for release v3.4.1 in region EU (canary 5%). Job id: r-20260321-02
Serena Patel: EU initial metrics: p50=68ms, p99=240ms, error_rate=0.5% — acceptable.
Alex Kim: Pre-warm triggered in EU: +2 hosts added, expected to finish in 90s.
Maya Nguyen: Reminder: If EU error_rate crosses 1% for 3m, we stop expansion and drop canary to 0%. If p99 spikes but error_rate stable, we keep and investigate model-level regressions.
Liam O'Connor: Cross-check logs: small tokenizer warning on a subset of prompts in EU, non-fatal. Serena is looking.
Serena Patel: Confirmed tokenizer warning, not affecting outputs. Pushing a hygiene patch isn't in this window.
Deploy-bot: EU hold completed at +31m, all green. Scheduling APAC warmup.
Maya Nguyen: APAC initial plan: 3% canary (smaller because regions have constrained reserved capacity). If stable, increase to 15% then 40%.
Alex Kim: APAC headroom: warm pool at 12% free — will borrow burst from dedicated standby but keep cushion >=8% for emergencies. Notifying infra.
Deploy-bot: Preparing APAC canary job -- requires manual approval due to low headroom.
Maya Nguyen: @Alex Kim can you approve APAC start? We need the extra standby unlocked.
Alex Kim: Approved. Unlocked 2 standby nodes.
Deploy-bot: Approved by Alex Kim. Started rollout for release v3.4.1 in region APAC (canary 3%). Job id: r-20260321-03
Liam O'Connor: APAC initial smoke: p50=75ms, p99=310ms, error_rate=0.9% — close to threshold, watching.
Serena Patel: Streaming tests show slight increase in tail latency for long chats (1000+ tokens). Investigating whether KV cache miss rate spiked.
Alex Kim: Observed spike in cache miss for a particular prefix — hit rate dropped from 84% to 60% for the first 10m after canary. Might be caused by TTL change.
Maya Nguyen: Given APAC headroom and current signals, let's pause expansion for 15m and monitor. If error_rate drops below 0.8% and p99 < 350ms, continue. Otherwise rollback APAC canary to 0 and revert TTL later.
Liam O'Connor: Agreed. Pausing expansion. Notifying on-call infra in case we need to scale more.
oncall-bot: Incident channel alerted: #eng-oncall — APAC canary paused for monitoring.
Maya Nguyen: After 12m metrics improved slightly: error_rate 0.7%, p99 300ms, cache hit creeping to 70%. Proceeding to step to 15% canary.
Deploy-bot: APAC canary bumped to 15%.
Serena Patel: Re-running long-chat regression suite against canary nodes. No semantic regressions detected.
Alex Kim: Standby nodes still available, but monitor GPU memory growth. If any OOMs, auto-fallback to v1 variant will trigger.
Liam O'Connor: All regions now at progressive rollouts with green checks. Recording notes for postmortem: watch TTL cache impact on APAC, consider incremental TTL revert plan for next deploy if needed.
Maya Nguyen: Thanks team — final step: open a release summary in the release board, include the APAC cache note and the canary metrics. I'll leave the thread open for 30m for any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
